ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio; approximately 1:18 high-intensity (white/scarring/glare) pixels to low-intensity (black pigmentation) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary substrate is uniform low-intensity black. High-contrast white mottling is mapped primarily to the distal tips and the proximal medial region near the peduncle insertion point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; internal angle estimated at 38 degrees relative to the medial axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Significant non-linear trailing edge; high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 5-12 units visible on the inner trailing margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to acute, pointed distal tips; leading edge exhibits a strong upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Stochastic distribution of high-intensity circular pixel clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) across the mid-ventral regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four parallel diagonal linear tracks (rake marks) on the left lobe; two distinct horizontal linear disruptions on the lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multi-linear rake mark scars on the left lobe; irregular jagged tissue loss on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
